# Security Policy

## Supported version

Security fixes are applied to the latest revision of `main`. Older commits,
forks, and third-party deployments are not supported.

## Report a vulnerability privately

Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting
form](https://github.com/mhju0/seoulsky/security/advisories/new). Do not open a
public issue or discussion for a suspected security problem.

Please include, when available:

- the affected route, component, dependency, or workflow;
- the impact and realistic attack scenario;
- reproducible steps or a minimal proof of concept;
- any suggested mitigation; and
- whether the issue is already public or actively exploited.

Do not include live credentials, personal data, or destructive exploit output.
Revoke exposed credentials before sending a report.

## Response and disclosure

The maintainer will make a best effort to acknowledge reports within 72 hours,
complete an initial triage within seven days, and coordinate disclosure after a
fix is available. Timelines may change with severity and upstream dependencies.

Good-faith research that avoids privacy violations, service disruption, data
destruction, and access beyond what is necessary to demonstrate the issue is
welcome.
